effects.instruction: Narrator only: the side event "Manhunt" resumes now: this turn's scene is that event, with the party present (arriving if need be), at the time of day the Current time note gives. Its setting: The party is now Most Wanted, and a new manhunt opens with this scene (any chase before it does not count): a coordinated operation closes in, run by a police task force with a top-ranked pro of the narration's choosing, one active at this point in the year, and the local agencies under that pro.
